mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees with clear skies at Fireman's Park. Tonight, look up at 5:47 PM to see the ISS rising over Cross Plains and heading toward the Madison area near Home Depot for a four-minute pass.
The City of Verona is planning a facility expansion for Public Works and Utilities to address population growth, while construction on Mark Drive remains ongoing with concrete work wrapping up.
Today, you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or Thursday night festivities at ART House 360, plus don't forget trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. tonight.
In a noteworthy incident on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was arrested for operating O W I after being found unresponsive in her vehicle.
Today's flavor is the delicious Double Strawberry, and since the store is open, you have plenty of time to stop by before they close at 10 PM.
